text:
Rina Patel: Heads up  got a batch of linkcheck failures after we ran the swagger-importer against latest spec. anchors with punctuation are getting encoded in the fragment and 404ing.
Owen Garcia: example?
Rina Patel: `#/api/create-user` expected but generated `#/api/create20user` (space encoded) and `#/guides/usage#connect—examples` became `#connect%E2%80%94examples` in the site output.
Linh Tran: ah, em-dashes and straight quotes in headings — the slugify step differs between the importer and the docusaurus/mkdocs slug rules.
Maya Brooks: which importer version? older one used a naive replace; newer slugs should call our canonical slugify util.
Rina Patel: importer v0.9.1; it looks like the converter kept the raw heading text so mkdocs slugify later encoded the punctuation.
Owen Garcia: short-term fix: add redirects for changed fragments in `redirects.yaml` so inbound links don't break. long-term: sanitize titles at import time and add tests.
Linh Tran: I'll open PR to sanitize: normalize unicode, replace em-dash with hyphen, remove extra spaces, then call slugify util. also add unit tests with examples that previously produced `%E2%80%94` or `%20`.
Maya Brooks: please add a migration note in the guides for anyone who might have bookmarked old anchors. also run `git grep -nP "[\u2013\u2014\u2018\u2019]" docs/` to find other occurrences.
docs-bot: CI: docs/linkcheck reported 7 broken fragments in branch fix/swagger-slugify  files: docs/guides/usage.md (line 88), docs/api/users.md (line 12)
Rina Patel: I pushed a small `redirects.yaml` patch mapping the key changed fragments to the new slugs. will follow up with importer PR.
Linh Tran: PR #4410 opened to sanitize importer output + tests. CC @Maya Brooks for changelog blurb.
Owen Garcia: linter request: can we add a docs-lint rule that fails if a generated slug contains percent-encoding like `%E2`? that will catch any future mismatches between slugify stages.
Maya Brooks: yes, add a check in the docs CI step that validates generated site slugs don't include `%` sequences. helpful to fail fast.
Rina Patel: local linkcheck now clean after redirects and importer patch. will run a broader repo sweep tomorrow.
Linh Tran: after landing, i'll add a note to the importer README about slug hygiene and include a tiny script to preview final slug for a heading.
Maya Brooks: thank you. follow-ups: Linh to land importer PR, Owen to add redirect entries for any remaining broken fragments, Maya to update docs changelog. will close thread after post-deploy monitoring.
Rina Patel: will monitor customer 404 alerts and post here if anything else crops up.
